# Instructions for accurately documenting failed advertised specifications in a consumer product performance report

1. Start with the test records.

completion:
Look for any recorded tests that did not meet the standards for performance specified in the product's advertising.
3. In the column titled "Description of Discrepancy," describe how the performance differs from the advertisement.
4. In the column titled "Advertisement Claim," specify the claim made in the advertising that was not met.
5. If multiple tests failed, record each one separately.
6. Once all the failed tests are recorded, summarize the data to recompile a complete consumer product performance report.
